body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 1 unit before rolling. On success, deal 2 weapon Damage; ignore the penalty for firing while adjacent to an enemy.

surges.html: Ignore all ordinary concealment and 1 point of cover bonus for this attack.

rider.title: Lock - Targeting
rider.html: After resolving, establish Lock. If it was already Locked, the next time it approaches you before your next turn you may move 1 unit away without triggering its movement Reactions.
